business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells outdoor wooden products and renewable energy products, with wooden products contributing 99.5% of 2024 revenue.

segments.item: Manufacturing and sales of wooden products
segments.business_substance: Outdoor wooden products and timber trading for domestic and overseas customers.
segments.source: Annual report note 5, revenue and segment reporting, pp.118-123

segments.item: Manufacturing and sales of renewable energy products
segments.business_substance: Biomass pellet fuel from wood-processing residue.
segments.source: Annual report note 5 and MD&A, pp.118-123

business_overview.revenue_model: Goods revenue recognised at a point in time upon delivery; trade receivables are normally due within 90-180 days from billing and deposits before delivery create contract liabilities.
business_notes: Revenue by geography: PRC 61,698; Australasia 281,188; North America 25,839; Europe 29,103; Asia Pacific excluding PRC 11,792, all RMB'000.
Four customers each contributed over 10% of revenue: 40,919, 98,335, 69,954 and 55,855 RMB'000.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Unconditional government subsidies for normal operating activities.

funds_assets.source: Consolidated statement of financial position and note 23, pp.62,146

funds_assets.business_substance: Australian Dollar denominated structured products of a Hong Kong investment bank.

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods.
Trade receivables, raw material trade deposits, interest receivables, prepayments and other receivables.
Buildings, plant, machinery, motor vehicles and land use rights used in production.

investment_assets.business_substance: Buildings leased out under operating leases; cost less depreciation/impairment.
Unlisted strategic investments in 5% and 1.3% equity interests of two PRC local banks in Zhangping City.

other_assets.item: Non-current deposits for acquisitions of PPE
other_assets.business_substance: Prepaid construction cost for plant and machinery.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Fixed-rate secured bank borrowings; RMB66.4m due within one year and RMB120.0m due in one to two years.
Unsecured, interest-free and repayable on demand; included in net debt movement.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual report note 27 and note 33, pp.150,161

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade and bills payables, accrued staff costs, PPE payables, transportation payables, other payables/accruals and medical compensation provision.
Receipts in advance from sales of wooden products.

other_liabilities.source: Consolidated statement of financial position, p.62
Consolidated statement of financial position, p.63

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2024 operating cash flow was positive but depended heavily on a RMB61.113m increase in trade and other payables; operating cash flow before working-capital movement was RMB12.393m. Three-year reported profit median was negative, and 2024 net profit was supported by a tax over-provision reversal and deposit interest.

gaps: Annual report does not split cash/time deposits by parent company, PRC operating subsidiaries and offshore subsidiaries.
Annual report does not disclose exact maturity ladder for current time deposits within 12 months.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; 2024 capex uses purchase of PPE plus deposit paid for PPE acquisitions.
2022 cash-flow and capex were not re-extracted from the 2022 annual report; 2022 profit came from the 2024 annual report five-year financial summary.
